preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 3 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n + 1 lines, where the last line is the guessed array.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('?') or line.startswith('!') for line in output[:-1])
postconditions.description: The output contains only lines starting with '?' or '!'.

postconditions.expression: all(line.isdigit() or line.startswith('!') for line in output)
postconditions.description: The output contains only digit lines or a line starting with '!'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[1]) <= n and int(line.split()[2]) <= n for line in output if line.startswith('?'))
postconditions.description: The indices in the '?' lines are within the bounds of the array length.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[1]) != int(line.split()[2]) for line in output if line.startswith('?'))
postconditions.description: The indices in the '?' lines are distinct.
The last line of the output starts with '!'.
